params.name: signal
params.description: OTLP signal type — one of logs, metrics, or traces.

items.docs:
Tests configured mapping of the source and its sinks against an example request body.

For HTTP sources the body is the raw payload that an HTTP client would send (treated as a single record).

For OTLP sources the body must be a single **flattened OTLP record** — a JSON object with the same shape that the source produces internally for each log record, metric data point, or span.
